gaps.title: 4-cycle-free incidence: every AND/OR fan-in-two circuit has a no-larger one whose ANDs are false at one-hot and non-incident point-line inputs
gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N + N) D ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) D z = true ↔ ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ p0 l0 : Fin N, ¬ I p0 l0 → (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun ke : Fin (N + N) => decide (ke = Fin.castAdd N p0 ∨ ke = Fin.natAdd N l0)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ (∀ j < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ p : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kc : Fin (N + N) => decide (kc = Fin.castAdd N p)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false) ∧ ∀ l : Fin N, (D.wires (List.ofFn (fun kd : Fin (N + N) => decide (kd = Fin.natAdd N l)))).getD (N + N + j) false = false)
gaps.unlocks: A weaker trade than 'some no-larger circuit is clean' that would carry the same bound: with the count for this weaker condition (a short step on this desk) it gives (edges - 1)/5 gates for every AND/OR circuit on these graphs.
gaps.context: SKETCH: No proof is expected here in one piece: propose a cut into smaller statements. It splits in two: first make every AND false at single inputs, then make every AND false at one point with one non-incident line. The first is open beyond small cases: hoisting an AND that is true at a single input can add gates, and one clause of that move has a 10-gate counterexample. The second is the junk question itself. On all 48 small classes with no 4-cycle every least circuit on file meets both (computed). No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

gaps.title: D-ledger: a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit for a 4-cycle-free edge function has |E| + tau(G - D) <= gates + |D| + 1, D its edges read twice at the output
gaps.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (T : Finset (Fin n)),
  PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover (G.deleteEdges ((G.edgeFinset.filter (fun e => ∃ u v : Fin n, e = s(u, v) ∧ PEqualNP.Core.ReadTwiceAt n C (C.output - n) u v)) : Set (Sym2 (Fin n)))) T →
  G.edgeFinset.card + T.card ≤ C.size + (G.edgeFinset.filter (fun e => ∃ u v : Fin n, e = s(u, v) ∧ PEqualNP.Core.ReadTwiceAt n C (C.output - n) u v)).card + 1
gaps.unlocks: an exact inequality: the only way a circuit can go below edges plus cover minus one is by re-reading edges
gaps.context: SKETCH: Three disjoint ledgers of gates. An AND reaching the output through ORs alone and accepting an edge once has a one-vertex side, since a rectangle with two vertices on each side is a 4-cycle: call that vertex its centre. The ORs under its other side have at least two inputs inside the centre's neighbourhood, so by no 4-cycle each belongs to one centre: leaf ORs are at least the sum of the star sizes minus the number of components. Productive ANDs are at least the components and at least tau(G - D). Size: 3 to 4 hours. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

gaps.title: Fork-share removal rewrite: in an AND/OR fan-in two circuit for a 4-cycle-free bipartite edge function, a private one-vertex gate read via ORs goes at no cost
gaps.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (col : Fin n → Bool) (C C0 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (T L : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ) (s : Fin n),
  (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → col u ≠ col v) →
  PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G →
  PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsOrTree n C T L C.output →
  (∀ w ∈ L, n ≤ w ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (w - n)).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and) →
  c < C.gates.length → PEqualNP.Core.InOutputCone n C c →
  PEqualNP.SplitCount.singletonSet n C c = {s} →
  (∀ k < C.gates.length, n + c ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).inputs → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) →
  (∀ k < C.gates.length, PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C c k → PEqualNP.Core.InOutputCone n C k →
    k ∈ T ∨ n + k ∈ L ∨ ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧
      ∃ w ∈ L, ∃ a ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (w - n)).inputs, PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C a k)) →
  (∀ j < C.gates.length, PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C j c → ∀ k < C.gates.length,
    n + j ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).inputs → k = c ∨ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n C k c) →
  C0 = ({ gates := C.gates.map (fun gg => ({ op := gg.op, inputs := gg.inputs.map (fun ww => if ww = n + c then (s : ℕ) else ww) } : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate)), output := C.output } : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) →
  (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C0 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput u v) = false →
    ∀ w ∈ L, PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C (w - n) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput u v) = true →
      ∀ a b : ℕ, ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (w - n)).inputs = [a, b] ∨ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C (w - n)).inputs = [b, a]) →
        PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches n C a c →
          PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C b (PEqualNP.SplitCount.unitInput u) = true ∨ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal n C b (PEqualNP.SplitCount.unitInput v) = true) →
  (Finset.univ.filter fun y : Fin n => ∃ z : Fin n, G.Adj z y ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C0 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput z y) = false).card ≤ (PEqualNP.Core.coneSet n C c).card ∧
  ∃ C' : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C' ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C' ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C' = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ ∧
    C'.size + (PEqualNP.Core.coneSet n C c).card ≤ C.size + (Finset.univ.filter fun y2 : Fin n => ∃ z2 : Fin n, G.Adj z2 y2 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C0 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput z2 y2) = false).card
gaps.unlocks: Removing a reused gate with a single-vertex part never costs a gate when its cone is private: one of the two shapes of reuse on the one-output line, priced.
gaps.context: SKETCH: Replace every read of the gate by its single vertex: the circuit can only fall, and it falls exactly on the lost edges. Those edges form a star forest: two lost edges sharing a leaf would close a 4-cycle with the vertex of the gate. The cone must read every vertex of the lost edges, so it has at least that many gates, all now deletable. Restore the lost edges with one star per component, reusing the leaf operands that are true alone at an end of each lost edge: at most as many gates as were deleted. Size: about 120 minutes. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (s : Fin n → Bool),

    ∀ i < D.gates.length, ∀ j < D.gates.length,
      (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and →
      (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and →
      ¬ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n D i j
gaps.unlocks: says a least circuit never needs an AND gate above another AND gate, on any bipartite graph

Size: open, hours to days; a counterexample goes to the negation on this desk. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

gaps.context: SKETCH: The same three moves as for edge functions, with f in place of the edge function. Take a least circuit; least size gives no dead gate. Lift: an OR not below f that reads a wire w below f can drop w and OR it onto the output, same size, and the number of such reads strictly falls, so it terminates. Sandwich: an AND reading a wire w below f is itself below f; replace it by OR-ing through the output so that no AND reads a below-f wire, without adding a gate; Size: 3 hours. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

  PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 7 C ∧ C.size = 11 ∧
  (∀ x : Fin 7 → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun 7 C x = decide (∃ e ∈ ([(0, 4), (0, 5), (0, 6), (1, 4), (2, 5), (3, 6)] : List (Fin 7 × Fin 7)), x e.1 = true ∧ x e.2 = true)) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ([(0, 4), (0, 5), (0, 6), (1, 4), (2, 5), (3, 6)] : List (Fin 7 × Fin 7)), PEqualNP.Core.ReadTwiceAt 7 C (C.output - 7) e.1 e.2 ↔ e ∈ ([(0, 4), (0, 5), (0, 6), (2, 5), (3, 6)] : List (Fin 7 × Fin 7))) ∧
  (∀ (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 7)) [DecidableRel G.Adj], (∀ u v : Fin 7, G.Adj u v ↔ ((u, v) ∈ ([(0, 4), (0, 5), (0, 6), (1, 4), (2, 5), (3, 6)] : List (Fin 7 × Fin 7)) ∨ (v, u) ∈ ([(0, 4), (0, 5), (0, 6), (1, 4), (2, 5), (3, 6)] : List (Fin 7 × Fin 7)))) →
    PEqualNP.Core.IsLiftFixedPoint G C) ∧
  PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrToOutput 7 C 9 ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C 9).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C 8).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C 4).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧
  PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches 7 C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C 9 1) 8 ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.OrReaches 7 C (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C 8 1) 4 ∧
  ∀ i : Fin 2, (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun z : Fin 7 => decide (z = 0 ∨ z = 4)))).getD (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C 4 i) false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun z : Fin 7 => decide (z = 4)))).getD (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd C 4 i) false = false

gaps.context: SKETCH: Let X = F u DSET (disjoint: AND against OR). Every x in X with n + x != output has a nontrivial ORP (n + x) output; its lowest step goes to an OR gate h reading n + x, and h has ORP to the output, so h is in DSET. Choose one such h(x). A fibre of h has at most 2 elements (distinct x read by h are distinct members of a list of length 2). So |X| - 1 <= 2 |DSET|, that is F.card + |DSET| - 1 <= 2 |DSET|. Size: about 30 minutes. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin 10), G = SimpleGraph.fromRel (fun a b : Fin 10 => ((a : ℕ), (b : ℕ)) ∈ ([(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 0), (0, 5), (1, 6), (2, 7), (3, 8), (4, 9), (5, 7), (7, 9), (9, 6), (6, 8), (8, 5)] : List (ℕ × ℕ))) →
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.AndCount.AndCountCircuit 10, C.WellFormed ∧ C.size ≤ 6 ∧
    (∀ v : Fin 10, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin C.size => v ∈ C.leftVars i ∨ v ∈ C.rightVars i)).card ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ I : Finset (Fin 10), (∀ a ∈ I, ∀ c ∈ I, ¬ G.Adj a c) → (∀ w : Fin 10, w ∉ I → ∃ a ∈ I, G.Adj a w) →
      C.eval I = false ∧ ∀ w : Fin 10, w ∉ I → C.eval (insert w I) = true)

gaps.title: One NOT gate saves nothing on Boolean sums of sets meeting pairwise in at most one point: at least the sum of (set size - 1) gates
gaps.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)), (∀ i : Fin m, 2 ≤ (S i).card) → (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) → ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∃ ι : Fin 1 → Fin gates.length, ∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ j : Fin 1, ι j = i) → (∀ (w : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S w, x v = true)) → (∑ i : Fin m, ((S i).card - 1)) ≤ gates.length
gaps.unlocks: The same question for every set system whose sets meet pairwise in at most one point
gaps.context: SKETCH: A conjecture with no argument held. A list with one NOT gate is, on each of the two convex pieces cut by the wire the NOT gate reads, a list without NOT gates; the recorded sum bound prices one piece. A charging argument cannot use the test input of the monotone count (an exit can be true at a single point and false at a pair holding it). In-house: no saving in any family decided (computed, not checked). No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

gaps.title: One NOT gate saves nothing on the line-ORs of a projective plane of order q: at least q times the number of lines gates
gaps.statement: ∀ (q m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin m)), 2 ≤ q → m = q * q + q + 1 → (∀ i : Fin m, (S i).card = q + 1) → (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card = 1) → (∀ p : Fin m, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => p ∈ S i)).card = q + 1) → ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∃ ι : Fin 1 → Fin gates.length, ∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ j : Fin 1, ι j = i) → (∀ (w : Fin m) (x : Fin m → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S w, x v = true)) → m * q ≤ gates.length

gaps.statement: ∃ (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)), (∀ i : Fin m, 2 ≤ (S i).card) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∃ ι : Fin 1 → Fin gates.length, ∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ j : Fin 1, ι j = i) ∧ gates.length + m + 1 ≤ ∑ i : Fin m, (S i).card ∧ ∀ (w : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S w, x v = true)

gaps.title: Plane of order 3: every list of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two with at most one NOT gate computing the 13 line-ORs has at least 39 gates
gaps.statement: ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin 13 → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∃ ι : Fin 1 → Fin gates.length, ∀ i : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → ∃ j : Fin 1, ι j = i) → (∀ (w : Fin 13) (x : Fin 13 → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ (({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)).image (fun u => u + w)), x v = true)) → 39 ≤ gates.length
gaps.unlocks: The first instance of whether one NOT gate saves anything on the line functions of a plane

First case: a non-monotone wire doing part of one line's OR. The two rows are a pair; one is true. In-house: nothing below the plain size in any decided case (computed, not checked). Data lane. gaps.title: Search: a counterexample to the clause lemma for one NOT gate on Boolean sums of sets sharing pairwise at most one input
gaps.statement: ∃ (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ) (i0 : Fin gates.length) (hw : ℕ) (T : Finset (Fin n)) (t0 : Fin n), (∀ i : Fin m, 2 ≤ (S i).card) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ q : Fin gates.length, (gates.get q).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → q = i0) ∧ (gates.get i0).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (gates.get i0).inputs.head? = some hw ∧ (hw < n + i0.val) ∧ (∀ (o : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S o, x v = true)) ∧ (∀ y : Fin n → Bool, (∀ t ∈ T, y t = false) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, hw⟩ (List.ofFn y) = false) ∧ (t0 ∈ T) ∧ (∀ t ∈ T, (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : Fin m => t ∈ S a)).card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Fin m => t0 ∈ S b)).card) ∧ gates.length + ∑ u ∈ T.erase t0, (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : Fin m => u ∈ S c)).card < 1 + ∑ s : Fin m, ((S s).card - 1)
gaps.unlocks: A counterexample would show where one NOT gate saves gates on Boolean sums, and place a saving at a threshold.
gaps.context: SKETCH: A search with exactly one NOT gate: enumerate small set systems (cycle rank three and up first), and for each a circuit below the stated bound, checked on all inputs. gaps.title: Search: a field, k lines of its plane with bases of at most b points and one function safe and two-point for all of them, with 2k above (b + 1)(b + 2)
gaps.statement: ∃ (F : Type) (_ : Field F) (n k b : ℕ) (pt : Fin n → Fin 3 → F) (l : Fin k → Fin 3 → F) (y : Fin k → Finset (Fin n)) (g : (Fin n → Bool) → Bool), (∀ p : Fin n, pt p ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ p p' : Fin n, p ≠ p' → ∀ c : F, pt p' ≠ c • pt p) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, l i ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin k, i ≠ j → ∀ c : F, l j ≠ c • l i) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, (y i).card ≤ b) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, ∀ p ∈ y i, ∑ t : Fin 3, pt p t * l i t ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin k) (x : Fin n → Bool), g x = true → ∃ p : Fin n, x p = true ∧ ∑ t : Fin 3, pt p t * l i t = 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin k, ∃ p p' : Fin n, p ≠ p' ∧ ∑ t : Fin 3, pt p t * l i t = 0 ∧ ∑ t : Fin 3, pt p' t * l i t = 0 ∧ g (fun v : Fin n => decide (v ∈ y i ∨ v = p)) = true ∧ g (fun v : Fin n => decide (v ∈ y i ∨ v = p')) = true) ∧ (b + 1) * (b + 2) < 2 * k

gaps.title: Every NOT gate at index t, the wire of t true below weight |y| and false at y: sets meeting y pay min(|y|, size), the others their size, refunds counted
gaps.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (o : Fin m → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (y : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) → (∀ g ∈ C.gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ i : Fin C.gates.length, (C.gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (i : ℕ) = t) → (∀ (i : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (o i) false = decide (∃ p ∈ S i, x p = true)) → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin n => x v = true)).card < y.card → (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (n + t) false = true) → (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun v : Fin n => decide (v ∈ y)))).getD (n + t) false = false → (∑ i : Fin m, if Disjoint (S i) y then (S i).card else min y.card (S i).card) ≤ C.gates.length + (Finset.univ.filter (fun g : Fin C.gates.length => (∃ i : Fin m, ∀ p : Fin n, (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun v : Fin n => decide (v = p)))).getD (n + g) false = true ↔ p ∈ S i) ∧ (∃ i : Fin m, Disjoint (S i) y ∧ ∀ p : Fin n, p ∉ y → ((C.wires (List.ofFn (fun v : Fin n => decide (v ∈ y ∨ v = p)))).getD (n + g) false = true ↔ p ∈ S i)))).card + m
gaps.unlocks: Charges the private gates of a circuit with NOT gates at one index on both windows of the NOT gate's wire, toward a sum over pieces.
gaps.context: SKETCH: on the window where the NOT gate's wire is false use the light-input sum bound; on the window where it is true use the heavy-input bound; sets meeting y pay min(|y|, size) and the rest pay on the other window. gaps.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool), n ≤ 7 → (∀ (j : Fin m) (x y : Fin n → Bool), (∀ i : Fin n, x i ≤ y i) → f j x ≤ f j y) → ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin gates.length, (gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → (gates.get j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → i = j) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out j⟩ (List.ofFn x) = f j x) → ∃ (gates' : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out' : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates', (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates', out' j⟩ (List.ofFn x) = f j x) ∧ gates'.length ≤ gates.length

gaps.title: Tile instance k = 3, affine plane of order 9: some AND/OR list of fan-in at most two, at most 160 gates, accepts all 486 off-pivot pairs soundly
gaps.statement: ∀ (inc : Fin 81 → Fin 81 → Prop) (onPiv : ZMod 3 → ZMod 3 → ZMod 3 → Fin 81 → Prop), (∀ Pi Li : Fin 81, inc Pi Li ↔ (((Pi.val / 9 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + ((Li.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * ((Pi.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = ((Li.val % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * ((Pi.val % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + ((Li.val / 9 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) ∧ ((Pi.val / 27 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = ((Li.val % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * ((Pi.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + ((Li.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * ((Pi.val % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + ((Li.val / 27 : ℕ) : ZMod 3))) → (∀ (ai mi gi : ZMod 3) (Pv : Fin 81), onPiv ai mi gi Pv ↔ (((Pv.val / 9 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + mi * ((Pv.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = mi * ai ∧ ((Pv.val / 27 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) = mi * ((Pv.val % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + gi)) → ∃ (Ckt : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (fg : ZMod 3 → ZMod 3 → ZMod 3 → ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 Ckt ∧ Ckt.size ≤ 160 ∧ (∀ ad md gd : ZMod 3, (Ckt.lineDegrees (81 + 81) (Finset.Ico 81 (81 + 81))).getD (fg ad md gd) 0 ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ Pa La : Fin 81, inc Pa La → ¬ onPiv ((Pa.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) ((La.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) (((La.val / 27 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + ((Pa.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * ((La.val % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3)) Pa → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (81 + 81) => if vq = Fin.castAdd 81 Pa then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd 81 La then true else false))).getD (fg ((Pa.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) ((La.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) (((La.val / 27 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) + ((Pa.val / 3 % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3) * ((La.val % 3 : ℕ) : ZMod 3))) false = true) ∧ (∀ (aw mw gw : ZMod 3) (zz : Fin (81 + 81) → Bool), (∀ Ps : Fin 81, onPiv aw mw gw Ps → zz (Fin.castAdd 81 Ps) = false) → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zz)).getD (fg aw mw gw) false = true → ∃ (Pe Le : Fin 81), inc Pe Le ∧ zz (Fin.castAdd 81 Pe) = true ∧ zz (Fin.natAdd 81 Le) = true)

gaps.title: Class P at line-degree 4: products of degree-2 wires, the first sound off a pivot line, cover at most 192 (size + J) + 8N diagonal pairs on it
gaps.statement: ∀ (N Jn : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (Ckt : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (fa fb : Fin Jn → ℕ) (Wl : Fin Jn → Fin N), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 Ckt → (∀ jd : Fin Jn, (Ckt.lineDegrees (N + N) (Finset.Ico N (N + N))).getD (fa jd) 0 ≤ 2 ∧ (Ckt.lineDegrees (N + N) (Finset.Ico N (N + N))).getD (fb jd) 0 ≤ 2) → (∀ (jb : Fin Jn) (zz : Fin (N + N) → Bool), (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zz)).getD (fa jb) false = true → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zz)).getD (fb jb) false = true → ∃ (pa lb : Fin N), I pa lb ∧ zz (Fin.castAdd N pa) = true ∧ zz (Fin.natAdd N lb) = true) → (∀ (js : Fin Jn) (zs : Fin (N + N) → Bool), (∀ ps : Fin N, I ps (Wl js) → zs (Fin.castAdd N ps) = false) → (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn zs)).getD (fa js) false = true → ∃ (pc lc : Fin N), I pc lc ∧ zs (Fin.castAdd N pc) = true ∧ zs (Fin.natAdd N lc) = true) → (Finset.univ.filter (fun e2 : Fin N × Fin N => I e2.1 e2.2 ∧ ∃ jc : Fin Jn, I e2.1 (Wl jc) ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (N + N) => if vq = Fin.castAdd N e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd N e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fa jc) false = true ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vq : Fin (N + N) => if vq = Fin.castAdd N e2.1 then true else if vq = Fin.natAdd N e2.2 then true else false))).getD (fb jc) false = true ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vp : Fin (N + N) => decide (vp = Fin.castAdd N e2.1)))).getD (fa jc) false = false ∧ (Ckt.wires (List.ofFn (fun vp : Fin (N + N) => decide (vp = Fin.castAdd N e2.1)))).getD (fb jc) false = false)).card ≤ 192 * (Ckt.size + Jn) + 8 * N
